details.name: Laevatain
details.quote: Haven't we met already? Hmph. Doesn't matter. You'll remember me by this sword and flame.
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Originium Arts: Sviga Laevi Burn the nemesis, light the bonfire, and purge the darkness. She is the destroyer. The annihilator. The defender.
details.exp2d: Situational Analysis: Intuition It was in the Woods of Memories where she touched the most realistic of illusions and the most unlikely of truths — And that was how she acquired her skills of observation.
details.hb1d: Creative: Collection of the Weird Only the most unique and interesting things deserve to be memorialized.
details.hb2d: Lifestyle: Traveling Vacation Desserts are good. Soft beds are great. Traveling is also pretty nice — It is far better to commit one's life to the future instead of obsessing about the past.
details.matskill: Forgeborn Scathe, Umbral Torch, White Night Nova
